courses.title: Communication Skills for Product Leaders
courses.description: Communication Skills for Product Leaders focuses on communication for people working toward a Product Strategist role, through hands-on exercises and short review checkpoints. It also introduces data storytelling, enough to apply alongside communication in real Product Strategist work. By the end, you'll be able to explain your approach to communication and show how data storytelling supports it.
learning_outcomes: Applying communication to a real Product Strategist scenario
Practicing communication through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to data storytelling
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Applying Roadmap Planning
courses.description: Applying Roadmap Planning goes beyond the basics of roadmap planning, for people already working toward a Product Strategist role. Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in roadmap planning and want to go further.

courses.description: Getting Started with Stakeholder Alignment is a short introduction to stakeholder alignment for people moving toward a Product Strategist role. The pace is gentle, with short lessons rather than a heavy project. It's a reasonable starting point if stakeholder alignment is new to you.
